strategyReview: The ONE_TOUCH_HIGH_EDGE_NO edge remains the standout performer with 4/4 live wins and +0.74 PnL, supported by solid shadow results (76/171, +0.84). PC_RATIO_EXTREME_LOW also continues to deliver (60% win, +0.07), especially on BTC and OIL. The WEEKEND_HL_FUNDING_REVERSION_LONG family is robust with 74% win rate and +1.29 PnL, affirming its eligible-live status. Funding extreme signals (FUNDING_EXTREME_LONG/SHORT) are underperforming, with low win rates and negative aggregate PnL on several assets, highlighting sensitivity to trend regimes. Disabled signals (PM_IV_GT_OPT_IV, OPT_IV_GT_PM_IV, LLM_HYPOTHESIS) show no reason for reactivation. The shadow pipeline reveals high-potential clusters (informed flow, rich PM IV touch, OIL/GOLD one-touch variants) that merit systematic hypothesis testing.

failureClusters.evidence: FUNDING_EXTREME_LONG on AMZN (29% win, -0.11), HYPE (33% win, -0.10), and overall 44% win rate with 11 stops out of 32 trades. FUNDING_EXTREME_SHORT on OIL (38% win, -0.01). High stop counts and frequent trend continuations after extreme funding suggest mean-reversion assumptions are failing on these assets.
failureClusters.recommendation: Tighten asset-specific entry filters (e.g., require short-term momentum confirmation) and consider raising stops to reduce premature exits. Disable FUNDING_EXTREME_LONG on HYPE in addition to already-disabled AMZN.

failureClusters.evidence: FUNDING_EXTREME_LONG_PM_PROXY_SHORT (20% win, -0.33) and PC_RATIO_EXTREME_LOW_PM_PROXY_SHORT (0% win, -0.61) both show heavy losses in shadow. Converting hyperliquid short signals into buying NO on Polymarket introduces basis risk and misalignment.
failureClusters.recommendation: Freeze active shadow promotion of these proxy short hypotheses. Prefer direct perp execution of the underlying funding/pc_ratio signals with tighter stop discipline rather than relying on PM proxies.

newHypotheses.description: Fade dumb-money highs: when the dumb-wallet share of YES volume on upside one-touch NO contracts exceeds 0.15 while smart-wallet share on dip-YES contracts remains below 0.05, sell the YES side of that upside NO contract as a directional short on the asset.
newHypotheses.prediction: The asset will fail to reach the upside strike, the NO contract will expire at 0, and the short position will be profitable.

newHypotheses.description: OIL one-touch NO edge with moderate edge strength and near-expiry refinement: when the sell-YES edge on an OIL upside one-touch NO contract is between 1 and 3 points and the contract expires within 30 days, short OIL by selling YES on that contract.
newHypotheses.prediction: The one-touch NO will expire out-of-the-money; the sold YES position will yield a profit equal to the edge captured.

newHypotheses.description: Rich PM IV NO fade on upside touch: when PM IV exceeds the 30-day options IV by at least 10 percentage points on an asset, and an upside one-touch NO contract exists with a positive sell-YES edge, short the asset by selling YES on that contract.
newHypotheses.prediction: The PM IV overpricing will correct, the asset will not reach the upside strike, and the short YES position will be profitable.

newHypotheses.description: Rich PM IV NO fade on upside touch, near-expiry filter: extend the PM IV rich signal (PM IV > opt_iv_30d + 10pp) to contracts expiring within 30 days, selling YES on upside one-touch NO contracts.
newHypotheses.prediction: Near-expiry contracts amplify the mispricing; the NO will expire OTM, yielding profit from selling YES.

newHypotheses.description: GOLD one-touch NO edge with near expiry: on GOLD upside one-touch NO contracts expiring within 30 days, when the sell-YES edge is positive (regardless of size), short GOLD by selling YES.
newHypotheses.prediction: The short YES position will capture edge the strong historical win rate (75% in shadow cluster) suggests a persistent GOLD overpricing on near-expiry upside touches.

newHypotheses.description: Rich PM IV with edge 3–8 points: when PM IV exceeds options IV by >10pp and the sell-YES edge on an upside one-touch NO contract is between 3 and 8 points, short the asset by selling YES.
newHypotheses.prediction: Larger perceived edge signals stronger mispricing, leading to higher profit probability within a 21-day window.

newHypotheses.description: Broad one-touch NO edge on all assets with above-direction and edge 3–8 points: for any asset, when the sell-YES edge on an upside one-touch NO contract is between 3 and 8 points, short the asset by selling YES.
newHypotheses.prediction: The edge range captures overpricing that reverts within 14 days, making the short YES position profitable across multiple assets.

newHypotheses.description: No-bias gap long signal on downside touch: when the no-bias adjusted gap is positive (sell edge) on a downside one-touch NO contract expiring within 30 days, go long the underlying asset (spot or perp), as the market is overestimating the probability of a downward touch.
newHypotheses.prediction: The asset will avoid hitting the downside strike, the NO contract will expire at 0, and the long position in spot/perp will benefit.

newHypotheses.description: GOLD short on extreme negative funding with no-bias gap: when gold funding is deeply negative (< -50% annualized) and the no-bias adjusted gap on a GOLD upside one-touch NO contract is positive, go short GOLD by selling YES on that contract.
newHypotheses.prediction: Extreme negative funding combined with a market overpricing of upside touch signals a continuation of downside momentum, making the short YES position profitable.

hypothesisReviews.observation: BTC PM IV regime-relative compression shows 2 wins in 4 hypothesis tests (50%). The thesis holds when PM IV z-score is below -2 and spot is near local highs, but low total win count and a live loss suggest the signal needs additional confirmation (e.g., options IV expansion or short-term momentum reversal) before promotion.

AMZN funding sign flip from deeply negative to positive has failed all 4 tests (0% win). The reversal from extreme negative funding often coincides with a spot rally that moves against the intended short trade, making the perp/spot convergence thesis unreliable.

LONG BTC momentum/vol-confirmed breakout has 50% win (8 tests). Recent tests show that while the momentum filter often identifies trending moves, the failure cases occur during sudden volatility shifts or fakeouts. Consider adding a regime filter (e.g., funding alignment) to improve the win rate.

AMZN extreme funding crash to -20% with negative basis shows two clean wins in two tests, but sample size is too small for any conclusion. Continue shadow testing with strict entry criteria; this signal is not yet ready for promotion.

journalEntry: Tonight's review confirms the ONE_TOUCH_HIGH_EDGE_NO and PC_RATIO_EXTREME_LOW signals remain healthy, while funding extreme signals continue to underperform on trend-sensitive assets. I increased FUNDING_EXTREME_LONG stop from 2.5% to 3.0% and FUNDING_EXTREME_SHORT stop from 2.0% to 2.5% to reduce premature stop-outs, given evidence of trend continuations after extreme funding. The shadow pipeline is rich: informed flow (FIND-0020) and edge-filtered one-touch clusters (OIL/GOLD, PM IV rich) all merit new hypotheses. I promoted 9 new hypotheses covering dumb-flow fading, OIL/GOLD one-touch edge refinements, and no-bias gap long/short setups. Active hypothesis reviews note that H-523, H-170 show mixed results needing more tests, while H-005 is a clear failure. H-259 is too early to judge.
